name: Ann Li
hometown: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States
intro: Ann Li is American. Her hometown has a funny name: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. Her favorite courts are grass courts. This year she cracked the top 30 for the first time.
story: Ann started tennis at age five. At 17 she reached the Wimbledon girls' final. This spring she got a big win over superstar Iga Swiatek in Madrid. Her parents came from China. Her whole family loves sports. She had a great run in New York this year. She won two matches. Then she pushed the No. 6 seed to three sets. A seed is a ranking badge for top players. Next time, watch that backhand!

funFacts.text: She plays the ukulele in her free time.
She loves country music. It helps her relax at tournaments.
Her dad played college soccer. Her mom ran track. Her aunt was a pro speed skater in China!
Roger Federer has been her idol since forever. She says he makes tennis look easy.
Besides music, she loves watching movies and reading books.
In 2017 she played an all-American Wimbledon girls' final. First one since 1979!
She won a tournament in Guangzhou, China, in 2025. Both her parents are from China.

watchFor: Watch her two-handed backhand, with both hands gripping the racket.
